name: Kate
source:
She is the enterprising young captain of her very own galactic galleon. Always on the search for adventure (or treasure), she's hit a bit of a dry spell lately and is bored to death. 

Fortunately, the arrival of a space pirate vessel brightens her day and after a short skirmish, Kate and her shipmate Yuria board the pirate ship to loot it of precious silver-platinum.

From "Angel Dust" story.
